name: endmes
literal_pieces:
PRESS RETURN TO RETURN TO THE PROGRAM
OR CLICK SOMEWHERE ELSE TO FIND OUT MORE

name: helpdraw
literal_pieces:
This button puts you in drawing mode.
Lines can be drawn in the STAMP DESIGN 
area by holding down the middle button,
and deleted by clicking
with the right one.

Little circles will appear if a line
touches the edge of the square.
These indicate positions on all the sides
that would contact that line in each of
the possible orientations of the print.
Unless special effects are being sought,
the recommendation is that all little
circles be attached to a line.

name: helptile
literal_pieces:
In this mode, orientations of the print
can be placed in the TILE DESIGN area
to create a 64 X 64 big tile

Use the right button to select a print
and the middle button to place it.

Within the tiling area the right button
may also be used to delete a square

To rotate or invert squares within
the big tile it may be more convenient
to use the ALTER mode.

name: helpalter
literal_pieces:
In ALTER mode, squares within the
big tile can be adjusted.
The middle button causes them to 
rotate clockwise.
The right button causes them to
invert.

name: helptclear
literal_pieces: This CLEAR button clears the TILE DESIGN
region and draws an empty grid.

name: helpt4
literal_pieces:
The T4 button tiles the whole big tile
with the pattern of the four squares
in the top left hand corner

name: helpquit
literal_pieces:
Clicking on QUIT allows you
to leave the program.

name: helpbt
literal_pieces:
Within the TILE DESIGN area,
a big tile, based on orientations of
a print design, can be built.

Using TILE mode the right button
will select from a palette at the bottom
of the screen, and the middle button will
place the selection within the big tile.
Within the area the right button will
delete squares.

Using ALTER mode the right button will
invert squares, and the middle button 
will rotate them.

name: helppic
literal_pieces:
These boxes show the eight possible
orientations of the print that is
to be used in tiling

When in tiling mode, clicking with the
right button over one of these
will make it the "current selection".
Clicking with the middle button in
the TILE DESIGN grid, will put that
orientation of the print at that place

name: helpdesign
literal_pieces:
This is the area in which to design 
your print.

Draw lines by holding down the
 middle button.
Delete lines by clicking with the
 right button.


A print that has previously been saved
can be restored by clicking on GET
then typing in the filename at the prompt.

name: helpdclear
literal_pieces:
This clears the PRINT DESIGN grid.
The print currently being worked on
will be lost, unless it has been
explicitly SAVEd first

name: errmes
literal_pieces:
You have clicked over an area 
of no particular interest.
